name: Bury St Edmunds
description: A Suffolk town dominated by its wealthy Benedictine abbey, long resented by townsmen for its feudal privileges. Stormed by John Wrawe's forces in mid-June 1381; Prior John Cambridge was caught fleeing and beheaded, and royal Chief Justice Sir John Cavendish was hunted down nearby at Lakenheath and killed.
story_hooks: The Suffolk rising's violence against the abbey
